question: Should WhatsApp immediately reject every injected media reader without explicit local roots while preserving the runtime-barrel re-export, or provide a temporary documented compatibility path for existing callers?
rationale: The old behavior widened reader access to any local root, while the new behavior can stop existing media sends; selecting the security and upgrade contract requires explicit maintainer ownership rather than an automated merge assumption.

options.title: Secure Additive Migration
options.body: Preserve the runtime-barrel re-export, require explicit roots immediately, and document and test the rejection as an intentional security hardening change.

options.title: Temporary Compatibility Adapter
options.body: Preserve the export and add a narrowly scoped, deprecated compatibility path only for a named shipped caller contract with a removal date and tests.

options.title: Pause For Caller Audit
options.body: Hold the PR until known runtime and plugin callers are audited for rootless injected readers and a migration plan is agreed.

recommendation.title: Secure Additive Migration
recommendation.body: Preserve the runtime-barrel re-export, require explicit roots immediately, and document and test the rejection as an intentional security hardening change.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent ownership signal across WhatsApp connection and delivery behavior and authored the current boundary change.
